verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Featurebase has an authenticated REST API and webhook signature verification. Nothing documents issuing API keys with restricted scopes, per-resource permissions, or least-privilege credentials for an agent. The API is described only as acting for 'the authenticated organization', and webhook signing is an adjacent security feature, not scoped credentialing.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
